newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes firmer on mark, dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes firmer on mark, dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed firmer at 994.50-995.50 per dollar from its opening 995-996 as foreign currency demand from banks and clients was low, dealers said.
* Foreign currency supply was also low as banks' lev liquidity was boosted by a 16.5 billion lev interest and maturity payment on a treasury bill issue.
* Spot dollar eased to 1,824-1,826 levs from the morning's 1,827-1,829 in line with the lev/mark and the dollar/mark cross on global markets.
* The lev has been pegged at 1,000 to the mark as an anchor currency under an IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate mechanism called a currency board system from July 1.

* Under the system, which requires levs in circulation to be fully matched by foreign currency reserves the central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks at 995 levs bid and 1,000 levs ask. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
